# PluginScope

Where something runs.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `User` | In the signed-in user's AutoSettings app, as that user. The default. |
| `Machine` | In the AutoSettings service, as SYSTEM, with full control of the computer. Only plugins installed for the whole computer (by an administrator) may have machine components, and only machine automations can use them. |
